whenToUse: Visible names for text inputs, text areas and checkboxes, each tied to its control by id
Marks beside the field name: required or optional, a status badge or dot, an info tooltip or an edit toggle
Field states and hints around the name: disabled, invalid, helper text under it and a live character count

whenNotToUse.when: Form rows that need hint and error slots, grouped sets or a side by side layout
The text box itself, with typed entry for email, password, number or file
Lists of tick boxes, a mixed state or selectable cards with a ticked state

agentNotes: Every `htmlFor` and its matching `id` is a fixed string such as `label-required`; make each pair unique when a field renders more than once
`data-disabled` on `Field` does not dim a plain `Label`, whose dim rule needs an unnamed `group` ancestor while `Field` is a named group
